title: Token Savings - Per Call

options.content: **Cost figures are config-priced estimates - directional, not invoice-grade.** Dollar values = token counts x a static pricing table; they exclude negotiated discounts, batch/reasoning surcharges, and currency effects. Provider prompt-cache discounts are priced from the cached tokens the provider reports, and the baseline gets the same discount when the request would have been cached without the proxy. baseline_* is a counterfactual. **Token-count savings are measured; dollar figures are estimates.** Provider-reconciled billing is a separate (non-OSS) concern.

panels.title: Total Tokens Saved
panels.description: From usage_events: this request's billing row.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tokens_saved FROM usage_events WHERE ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND request_id = '${request_id}' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Savings %
panels.description: From usage_events: this request's billing row.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((CASE WHEN baseline_tokens = 0 THEN 0 ELSE tokens_saved * 100.0 / baseline_tokens END)::numeric, 2) FROM usage_events WHERE ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND request_id = '${request_id}' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Cost Saving (USD)
panels.description: From usage_events: this request's billing row. Cost saved includes the estimated input cost a cache hit avoided.

targets.rawSql: SELECT cost_saved_usd FROM usage_events WHERE ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND request_id = '${request_id}' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Model Routed
panels.description: From usage_events: this request's billing row.

targets.rawSql: SELECT routed_model FROM usage_events WHERE ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND request_id = '${request_id}' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Cache Hit
panels.description: From usage_events: this request's billing row.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN cache_hit THEN cache_level ELSE 'miss' END FROM usage_events WHERE ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND request_id = '${request_id}' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Savings by G-Group (tokens)
panels.description: From usage_events: this request's billing row. Only groups that saved tokens are listed: one that added tokens (e.g. retrieval context) is left out, though the request totals still count it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT key AS group, value::int AS tokens_saved FROM usage_events, jsonb_each_text(group_savings) WHERE ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND request_id = '${request_id}' ORDER BY tokens_saved DESC

panels.title: Step-by-Step Savings Detail
panels.description: From usage_events: this request's billing row. Only groups that saved tokens are listed: one that added tokens (e.g. retrieval context) is left out, though the request totals still count it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT key AS "G-Group", value::int AS "Saved", ROUND((CASE WHEN baseline_tokens = 0 THEN 0 ELSE value::int * 100.0 / baseline_tokens END)::numeric, 2) AS "% of Baseline" FROM usage_events, jsonb_each_text(group_savings) WHERE ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${team}' = '.*' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') = '${team}') AND request_id = '${request_id}' ORDER BY key

panels.title: Langfuse detail: needs Langfuse tracing (G18_observability.langfuse_enabled: true)

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, type, start_time, end_time, (input::text) as input_summary, (output::text) as output_summary FROM observations WHERE trace_id = '${request_id}' ORDER BY start_time
SELECT name, value, comment FROM scores WHERE trace_id = '${request_id}' ORDER BY name

list.label: Team
list.description: The authenticated team (usage_events.team; 'default' = no team, which also covers rows written before teams existed). Filters every panel that reads usage_events; Prometheus panels are not filtered by team.
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') AS team FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(team, ''), 'default') AS team FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') ORDER BY 1
